sampling.eligible_population: physical Stage-0 parquet rows after excluding the prior 100-row audit and all rows in smiles_identity_audit.jsonl
sampling.rank_rule: within each source, sort eligible zero-based row indices by (sha256(seed + NUL + source_id + NUL + decimal_row_index), row_index); take the lowest allocation; present selected rows in numeric order
sampling.sample_manifest_serialization: compact JSON array of {source_id,row_index}, source order then ascending row_index
sampling.note: The exact selected manifest and its hash were frozen after applying both exclusion sets; the prior 100 ledger is not duplicated in this artifact.
